verified_sources.verified_claim: DTM is terrain-only, uses EPSG:27700, has stated vertical accuracy +/-15cm RMSE, and exposes WCS plus survey metadata services.
2m DTM covers about 99% of England; surface objects are removed; repeat surveys use newest best-resolution data; survey metadata identifies the source survey for a location.
10m DTM is resampled from the 2m DTM using bilinear interpolation and retains the stated +/-15cm RMSE source accuracy statement.
DSM includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain, so it must not be treated as terrain height.

verified_sources.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_sources.verified_claim: Time-stamped DTM is delivered in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn, aligned to OS Grid, and uses a transformation specific to survey period.
Persistent WCS endpoints are documented for 1m and 2m DTM and DSM services.

accuracy_effect: Separates terrain from object surface heights, records resolution/resampling and survey epoch, and blocks mixed-resolution or stale-epoch promotion without runtime parcel evidence.
